journey.name: repay paid invoice
journey.description: Paying again a Lightning invoice this wallet already paid ends the swipe: the Confirm screen moves on to the Success sheet of the earlier payment instead of keeping its swipe spinner. Spark skips the second payment, so nothing is sent twice. Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with at least 5 000 sats in Spark and no Lightning channel (a channel pays over the node, which refuses the repeat with an error instead), QuickPay off, and a 1 000-sat Lightning invoice from another node (for example `./spark invoice 1000` on the bitkit-docker Spark stack), handed to the app as a deep link. The Success sheet's own tag ("SendSuccess") sits on a wrapper `android layout` leaves out, so the steps check its Close button. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Verify the Confirm screen (tag "SendConfirm") shows 1 000 sats; swipe to pay
Verify the Success sheet opens within 30 seconds, with its Close button (tag "Close"); tap Close and verify the wallet home screen is visible, with the spending balance lower by about 1 000 sats
Run the same `adb shell am start … "lightning:<invoice>" …` command again with the same invoice
Verify the Confirm screen (tag "SendConfirm") shows 1 000 sats again; swipe to pay
Verify the Success sheet opens within 30 seconds, with its Close button (tag "Close"); without the fix the swipe kept its spinner on Confirm until Back
Tap Close and verify the spending balance did not drop a second time, and the home activity list shows one Sent row for this invoice
